result.instructions: PdfCraft edits PDFs. Open a file with doc_open to get a document id, then inspect (doc_info, text_extract, text_find, page_render) or edit it (page_*, doc_set_info). Edits are undoable (edit_undo) and stay in memory until doc_save. Page numbers are 1-based. Open documents are also resources: pdfcraft://doc/{doc}/info, /text, /page/{page}/text and /page/{page}/image. command_list discovers command ids and tool schemas; command_run executes one, command_batch runs several. doc_inspect returns open document state; render_preview returns a bounded PNG. Only a core set of tools is listed. Every other tool is still available: find it with tool_search (optional query and category, or name for its full input schema) and run it with tool_call.

tool.description: Mark content for redaction (nothing is removed until redact_apply). One of: rect [x0, y0, x1, y1] (points from the top-left of the displayed page) with page; find (text, every match); words (a list of words or phrases, every match of each; the result's matched_words says how many marks each made); pattern (phone, email, credit-card, ssn, date: every match, Acrobat's Search & Redact patterns); whole_pages: true. find and words accept case_sensitive and whole_words (both default false). find, words, pattern and whole_pages work on pages (default all). overlay: text shown on the box once applied, or code_set (foia: U.S. FOIA (b)(1)(A)…(b)(9); privacy-act: U.S. Privacy Act (d)(5), (j)(1)…(k)(7)) with codes, shown as "(b)(6), (b)(7)(C)"; fill: box colour (default black). Undoable.

case_sensitive.description: Match letter case for find or words (default false).

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers to search or mark (default: all).

whole_words.description: Match whole words for find or words (default false).

tool.name: redact_mark
tool.title: Mark for redaction

tool.description: Export a PDF ▸ Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx, one slide per page), HTML (.html, one file with images inline) or RTF (.rtf), chosen by path's extension: text, headings, bold and italic. Word uses borderless inferred tables and positioned editable shapes on pages with artwork, rotated or large text; each source page retains its size. Font matching and vector graphics remain limited.

tool.name: doc_export_office
tool.title: Export to Word, PowerPoint, HTML or RTF

tool.description: Find faux redactions: opaque filled rectangles painted over text that is still extractable, and /Redact annotations that were marked but never applied. Paint-order and colour-aware: a rectangle counts only when painted after the text and dark enough to hide it (page backgrounds and light shading are not flagged). Each finding reports the 1-based page, the kind (covered-text or unapplied-mark), the rectangle (points from the top-left of the displayed page, like comment_list), and the hidden text. Fails closed: unreadable content is an error, never a clean bill. A properly applied redaction removes the text and never flags.
